title: Alchemy 101
source_topic: ICPC / The 2020 Asia Can Tho Regional Contest
statement: Substances are numbered by positive integers and combining two yields the substance whose number is their bitwise xor. Only substances one through m are available and none may be reused. For each of up to one thousand test cases, with m at most one thousand, the task is to report the largest collection whose xor equals m, choosing the lexicographically smallest such list.
